name: RC Migrate
description: Migrate channels from Mattermost to Rocket.Chat by blocking posts and redirecting users.

settings_schema.header: Settings for the RC Migrate plugin.

settings.help_text: Base URL for your Rocket.Chat instance (e.g. https://rc.example.com). Used for display purposes only.

settings.default: This channel has moved to Rocket.Chat
settings.help_text: Message shown to users who try to post in a migrated channel. Supports markdown.
Shared secret for the REST API. Required for external tools (e.g. Rocket.Chat import app) to trigger migrations remotely. Leave empty to disable the API.
